name: Russ Vought

lean.basis: Career Republican operative (Republican Study Committee, House Republican Conference, Heritage Action); Trump's budget director in both terms and a primary architect of Project 2025; calls himself a defender of an "older definition of conservatism".

source.title: File:Russell Vought, official portrait (2025) (cropped1).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: Director of the Office of Management and Budget (since February 2025)
summary: Russ Vought is Trump's budget director, a post he also held from 2020 to 2021, and a primary architect of the Heritage Foundation's Project 2025. He co-founded Heritage Action (2010) and founded the Center for Renewing America (2021). In 2025–26 he also ran the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau and USAID on an acting basis and pressed deep cuts alongside DOGE. He spoke at NatCon for the first time in September 2025.

sources.title: OMB Director: How President Trump Is Deconstructing the Administrative State — Daily Signal

connections.name: Mike Pence
connections.description: Pence, as House Republican Conference chairman, made Vought its policy director at the start of the 111th Congress (Wikipedia says December 2008); Vought left in July 2010 for Heritage Action. Pence later helped bring him into the Trump administration.

connections.description: Fellow architects of Trump's second-term agenda: Miller, now deputy chief of staff, called Vought a "transformative pick" for OMB; Vought's Center for Renewing America and Miller's America First Legal worked in tandem before 2025.
